notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Shocker.
Shocker does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent that has at least two cards in hand controls a Wedding Ring.
description:
During an opponent's turn who controls a Wedding Ring, activate Shocker by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Shocker triggers, causing the opponent to discard their hand and draw that many cards.
The Wedding Ring you control triggers for each card drawn, causing you to draw that many cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Shocker.
Repeat.
